list: the official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (names, descriptions, grades, PSN counts and hidden/visible split all agree)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The capstone: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done, so there is no separate task here. Work the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum at about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty: long, not hard. There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so nothing is gated behind a hard mode.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. If it has not popped yet, keep playing — chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Automatic and unmissable; it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — that one may be missable, and this chapter is your only chance at it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Automatic and unmissable; it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens during this chapter, and most of the list only opens up once both are playable together.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. While you are in Chapter 3, do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand the moment it appears (hourglass icon) — that strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable; it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Bank vault robberies open near the end of this chapter, so the robbery trophies start here — see Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and the credits roll on Chapter 5. Automatic and unmissable. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your safety net for anything story-linked. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave — keep one at the start of each chapter.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed — just play through the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed — just play through the story in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed — just play through the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. Automatic and unmissable. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam plane theft at the same airport — that one you do yourself, outside the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. It asks for more than the trophies in places — 300 stunts (not 250), 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 meditation spots — so expect this to be the last gold you earn, just before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 are not wasted. Stunts are cumulative across the whole game, so fold them into normal driving and flying instead of grinding them in one sitting.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (PSN tracks 0/9). The exact nine are not published yet, so play one session of each activity the game offers — shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, meditation, bowling, gym training, hunting — and watch the counter move. This guide will name the nine once they are confirmed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. Gold medals are a skill gate, not a grind: practise each challenge until the gold time or score is met, and use the range as a warm-up whenever you pass one. The PSN counter reads 0/42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, PSN counter 0/14. Win at least one race at each spot; you do not need to win every race type at a location, just one win per location. Work through the locations in order and tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (PSN 0/20). 'Different' is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so work through the race list — street races, drone races and any other race type — and keep a note of which you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The opening mission Gone Fishing introduces fishing; challenge Cal when a fishing challenge is offered and win the contest. Fishing is one of the activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to the end — any arcade game counts. This is one of the easiest bronzes; do it early so it is banked.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so this cannot be missed — finish Andy's strand when it is offered and the finale unlocks. Note: Andy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks, which has its own 8 strands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during the story, but all trophy-related quest givers return later, so the finale stays doable in free roam after the credits. Just keep playing his strand when he is around.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Finish the strand's missions in order; the finale stays available after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida (PSN 0/8). Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do NOT, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted. One strand is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 (Yago's street racing strand, hourglass icon) — do it the moment it appears, and save first.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand; the finale stays open after the story in free roam, so this cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Finish the strand and the finale unlocks; it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations (PSN 0/18). THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning; Lucia says she is going to meditate, then walks out to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether it is required — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Outdoor spots show as purple icons when you are close; each should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine — take the careful shot rather than spraying. The questline stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (PSN 0/3). Cards are a collectible hunt across Leonida — collect full sets and three completed sets pop the trophy. Card locations are not yet mapped in a confirmed guide, so sweep areas as you explore and track your sets in the in-game collection menu. Cards also appear in places you revisit, so do not worry about missing one in a story building.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations (PSN 0/100). WAiNK is the in-game app — use it to scan or tag at 100 distinct locations as you travel. Fold it into exploration: WAiNK a spot whenever you arrive somewhere new and the count climbs without a dedicated grind. Note: scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (PSN 0/50). Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges and many complete on their own while you play. 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so push past 50 rather than stopping — the same list feeds both, and the extra 20 are the same kind of tasks.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest paired with Maximum Withdrawal: vault jobs give a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escape one with your partner and both trophies can pop. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (PSN 0/100). Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past 100 and the trophy becomes a milestone on the way to the gold.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle — Adrenaline extends Focus, giving you time for all five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed, so fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') means getting into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. The exact trigger is reported, not yet confirmed in-game — if it does not pop, try driving and firing the cannon before leaving the area.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape (PSN 0/5). Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away — escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% completion needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads — hit one, grab the cash and escape the heat. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Pair it with vault runs: tailing an armored van is also how bank vaults open (see Maximum Withdrawal).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas (PSN 0/52). Drive and fly through every named area until the counter fills; the in-game map and the counter are your checklist. Fold this into the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery sweeps rather than doing a separate lap of the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs (PSN 0/9). One operation per gang is enough for the trophy, but 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so keep robbing them after it pops. If you leave valuables behind, an operation comes back later, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description points to having a drink somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned down the exact bar or trigger yet. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach; this entry will be updated when a trigger is confirmed. Treat it as a free-roam trophy, not a story one.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the likely trigger is driving a car out through a showroom's front window, but the exact showroom and conditions are not confirmed yet. Do not waste money smashing random showrooms until a trigger is confirmed; this entry will be updated.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reported, not yet confirmed: it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you. If max Strength on both does not pop it, the trigger is something else and this entry will be corrected.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — 500 of them (PSN 0/500). The counter tracks actions that change your Criminal Profile: robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Just play the game — robbing, fighting and making choices — and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no guide has pinned down the exact event yet. Do not chase it blindly; this entry will be updated when a trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description suggests a strange one-off event or encounter, but the exact trigger is not yet known. Keep playing and exploring; one-off world events are the likely source, and this entry will be updated when one is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact conditions are not confirmed yet. Try a melee drive-by on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car; this entry will be updated when the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (PSN 0/250000). Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling to your contacts. The total is cumulative, so bank the bills as you earn them rather than holding them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (PSN 0/100000). The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — weapons, clothes, food, cars and property upkeep all count. It pops naturally if you buy the eight garages for Little Boxes first.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages (PSN 0/8). Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy garages before registering cars for On the Spot — each car needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (PSN 0/10). The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
